upstream_definition: time-resolved pressure at the explicitly stated injector/supply location and pressure type
comparison_constraints: pressure role; absolute/gauge; spatial location; time reference; valve state
normalization_requirements: preserve reported history and link event/time-history IDs
main_limitations: Sparse direct injector-internal histories across papers
notes: Do not replace with nominal rail pressure.

upstream_definition: time-resolved numerator pressure divided by ambient/back/chamber pressure with both roles typed
comparison_constraints: numerator role/type/location/time basis; denominator role/type/location/time basis; transient state
normalization_requirements: use ratio_definitions; do not combine incompatible NPRs
main_limitations: Not all papers report definition-complete time histories
notes: Generic pressure ratio is not comparison-ready.

upstream_definition: static ambient/chamber/back pressure with absolute/gauge basis
downstream_response: jet timing penetration and lateral growth
comparison_constraints: fixed NPR versus fixed injection pressure; ambient density and temperature
normalization_requirements: SI absolute pressure only after pressure type is verified
main_limitations: Coupled changes can obscure direction
notes: Also forms the NPR denominator in many but not all studies.

upstream_definition: exit diameter, shape, L/D, hole count, spacing, and orientation
downstream_response: shock topology shear-layer growth and jet interaction
comparison_constraints: compare homologous geometry and diameter basis
normalization_requirements: normalize distance/spacing by the documented exit scale
main_limitations: No common factorial geometry dataset
notes: Mach-disk x/D requires the same D definition.

upstream_definition: species, equation of state, sound speed, density, temperature, and compressibility state
downstream_response: shock cells potential core and mixing
comparison_constraints: matched NPR does not match density, speed of sound, or real-gas exit state
normalization_requirements: retain species and thermodynamic model; normalize only verified states
main_limitations: Species and turbulence effects remain coupled
notes: Needed before mapping gas fields to droplet loading.

upstream_definition: axial Mach-disk location divided by a documented nozzle diameter
comparison_constraints: formation/instantaneous/overshoot/stabilized state; compatible NPR and nozzle geometry
normalization_requirements: SI distance and explicit D basis; event-align transient values
main_limitations: Does not itself provide droplet loading
notes: More comparison-ready than diameter or curvature.

upstream_definition: distance between explicitly defined shock-cell features
downstream_response: spatial modulation of local gas state
comparison_constraints: feature definition; cell index; near/far field; gas/nozzle/NPR
normalization_requirements: normalize by documented nozzle scale only
main_limitations: Sparse and less constrained than Mach-disk position
notes: Not interchangeable with potential-core length.

upstream_definition: pre/post-wave or local extrema defined at a specified location and time
downstream_response: droplet normal loading and internal wave response
comparison_constraints: wave origin; pressure type; pre/post states; location; reacting versus inert
normalization_requirements: use consistent state pair and SI pressure
main_limitations: Not measured at HPDI pilot droplets
notes: A necessary B-to-C bridge variable.

upstream_definition: post-wave/local gas velocity minus droplet or preshock reference in a stated frame
comparison_constraints: laboratory versus droplet-fixed frame; post-shock versus local relative velocity
normalization_requirements: normalize only after frame and state are verified
main_limitations: Jet-field velocity histories are not co-located with pilot droplets
notes: Do not substitute spray-tip velocity for nozzle/local gas velocity.

upstream_definition: typed interval: shock-front passage, shocked-state exposure, expansion-limited loading, or total forcing
comparison_constraints: interval type; start/end events; local versus global exposure
normalization_requirements: link interval and event IDs; convert units without changing definition
main_limitations: Definitions are heterogeneous
notes: Generic loading time is not comparison-ready.

upstream_definition: incident shock propagation speed divided by preshock sound speed
downstream_response: shock strength and post-shock loading context
comparison_constraints: incident shock only; do not equate to post-shock freestream or detonation Mach
normalization_requirements: retain parameter_context and reference frame
main_limitations: Same M_s can produce different reacting post-wave histories
notes: Definition-complete but not sufficient alone.

upstream_definition: local gas-droplet relative speed divided by a stated local sound speed
comparison_constraints: gas state; sound-speed state; droplet velocity; frame
normalization_requirements: derive only if all components are verified and mark derived
main_limitations: Rarely reported directly
notes: Prefer over generic Mach for local loading when available.

upstream_definition: rho_ref U_ref^2 L_ref / sigma with every reference component linked
comparison_constraints: velocity; density; length; surface tension; Mach context; loading history
normalization_requirements: use dimensionless_definition_id and exact components
main_limitations: Comparable We alone does not ensure comparable response
notes: Definition-complete We is core; generic We is not.

upstream_definition: rho_ref U_ref L_ref / mu_ref with gas/liquid viscosity role explicit
downstream_response: viscous influence on flow and breakup
comparison_constraints: velocity; density; length; viscosity phase; state and frame
normalization_requirements: use linked component records
main_limitations: Coverage and definition completeness are uneven
notes: Supporting rather than single organizing variable.

upstream_definition: mu_l / sqrt(rho_l L_ref sigma) or source-reported equivalent
comparison_constraints: liquid viscosity/density; length; surface tension; temperature
normalization_requirements: use linked liquid-property state
main_limitations: Often omitted or incomplete
notes: Required for cross-liquid regime comparison.

upstream_definition: explicit gas-to-liquid or liquid-to-gas density ratio at documented states
comparison_constraints: ratio orientation; gas/liquid states; post-shock versus ambient
normalization_requirements: normalize orientation without losing reported definition
main_limitations: Not consistently reported
notes: Especially important when phase change changes near-interface gas state.

upstream_definition: initial parent-droplet diameter or documented distribution metric
downstream_response: deformation time breakup mode and evaporation scale
comparison_constraints: initial versus instantaneous; single value versus distribution metric
normalization_requirements: convert to SI and retain size statistic definition
main_limitations: Polydisperse spray transfer cannot use one nominal d0
notes: Core cross-scale length.

upstream_definition: ordered spacing ratio or explicit volume fraction/number density/distribution statistic
comparison_constraints: tandem versus parallel; spacing basis; cloud volume fraction; arrangement
normalization_requirements: retain descriptor type; do not map unlike descriptors to one S/D
main_limitations: No universal critical spacing across arrangements
notes: Dense spray requires richer descriptors.

upstream_definition: time to a defined deformation event relative to shock or loading onset
comparison_constraints: event definition; time zero; scaling time; observation method
normalization_requirements: link event and history IDs
main_limitations: Definitions and available histories vary
notes: May support a future loading/response ratio only as hypothesis.

upstream_definition: time to onset, first shedding, or completion with event definition
comparison_constraints: breakup event; loading history; time scale; liquid and Mach context
normalization_requirements: use event/interval IDs and preserve reported definition
main_limitations: Generic breakup time mixes non-equivalent events
notes: Use only definition-matched comparisons.

upstream_definition: reported morphology or mechanism label under explicit forcing conditions
comparison_constraints: taxonomy; We/Mach/loading definition; observation window
normalization_requirements: retain source label and mapped controlled class separately
main_limitations: Taxonomy boundaries are not universal; C004 missing
notes: Useful for mechanism maps rather than universal numeric thresholds.

upstream_definition: time-resolved fragment statistic or PDF with detection and sampling definition
comparison_constraints: D10/D32/PDF basis; time; detection threshold; mass versus number weighting
normalization_requirements: preserve distribution statistic and units
main_limitations: Data density is low
notes: Single mean size is insufficient where distributions are multimodal.

upstream_definition: typed droplet survival/evaporation interval or distance
downstream_response: vapor availability and strong-wave scale coupling
comparison_constraints: evaporation completion criterion; gas history; liquid; frame; geometry
normalization_requirements: use SI and retain time versus length distinction
main_limitations: Often model-dependent or application-specific
notes: Do not merge evaporation time and length into one scalar.

upstream_definition: time from a named injection/mixture event to a named ignition event
comparison_constraints: reference SOI/EOI; ignition definition; crank-angle versus time; operating point
normalization_requirements: link both event IDs and sign convention
main_limitations: Definitions differ across engine/vessel studies
notes: Directly useful when event definitions match.

upstream_definition: signed separation between explicitly identified pilot and main-fuel SOI events
comparison_constraints: fuel order; sign convention; crank-angle/time basis; dwell versus overlap
normalization_requirements: use interval/event IDs; retain sign convention
main_limitations: Same magnitude can represent opposite chronology
notes: Core A-library comparison parameter.

upstream_definition: evaporation length divided by a named detonation/reaction/refill characteristic length
comparison_constraints: definitions of both lengths; fuel; chemistry; geometry; wave number
normalization_requirements: retain source ratio definition; no HPDI remapping without validation
main_limitations: Not a validated HPDI scale
notes: Useful within RDE; cross-domain use is analogue only.
